Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit: Career, Experience, and Contributions to the Indian Air Force

04 Nov 2026, 04:14 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.amarujala.com

Introduction

Publicly available reports outline the career background, flying experience, and command assignments of Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit, detailing his transition from an experimental test pilot to key leadership roles within the Indian Air Force (IAF).

Flying Experience and Aircraft Handled

According to official service profiles, Air Marshal Dixit is a qualified flying instructor and experimental test pilot with more than 3,300 hours of flying experience. Public records state that he has operated over 20 types of aircraft, including:

  • Fighters: Mirage-2000, MiG-21 and other variants, Jaguar, and LCA Tejas.
  • Trainers and Transports: HPT-32, An-32, Avro, Kiran, and Hawk.
  • Specialized Aircraft: IL-78.

Key Leadership and Staff Appointments

Reports indicate that Air Marshal Dixit has held several critical command and staff positions within the defence establishment:

  • Vice Chief and Integrated Defence Staff: He has served in senior roles including Chief of Integrated Defence Staff (CISC) and Vice Chief of the Air Staff.
  • Command Positions: He served as the Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief of the Central Air Command and commanded a frontline fighter base in the western sector as well as a fighter training base in the southern sector.
  • Air Headquarters Roles: His tenure includes serving as Assistant Chief of the Air Staff (Projects) and Assistant Chief of the Air Staff (Plans).
  • Specialized Postings: He commanded a Mirage-2000 squadron and oversaw the ferry and induction process of new Mirage aircraft from France. He also served as Commanding Officer of the Flight Test Squadron at the Aircraft and Systems Testing Establishment (ASTE) in Bengaluru.

Operational Participation and Technological Contributions

Publicly reported service records highlight involvement in various military operations and developmental programs:

  • Operations: Reports note participation in Operation Safed Sagar during the 1999 Kargil conflict, Operation Rakshak in Jammu and Kashmir, Cope India, and Operation Sindoor.
  • Indigenous Programs: He is noted as a proponent of domestic aerospace projects, including the LCA Tejas and the 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' defence manufacturing initiatives.
  • Upgrades and Testing: During his tenure at ASTE, he contributed to avionics upgrade programs for Jaguar and MiG-27 aircraft. As Director of Air Staff Requirements, he was involved in the technical evaluation and testing planning for medium multi-role combat aircraft.
  • Strategic Planning: Official announcements indicate that during his tenure as CISC, frameworks for joint military doctrines, 'Ransanvaad', and the 'Defence Forces Vision 2047' roadmap were advanced.

Verification and Further Information

Readers seeking verified and updated details regarding Indian Air Force appointments, official policy documents, and defence announcements are advised to consult official portals of the Ministry of Defence and the Indian Air Force.
